strategies.name: Detection of File and Directory Discovery

analytics.name: Analytic 1788
analytics.guidance: For Android, detect File and Directory Discovery by correlating analyst-visible device/network evidence and management state; use streaming or batched telemetry only where the documented collector is deployed. Correlate Application State via Android Enterprise / EMM [Managed package inventory/status and package metadata]; File Access via Application Vetting / Forensic Acquisition [Dynamic filesystem trace or acquired app-container/filesystem artifacts: opendir() or File.listFiles() on path IN $ExternalStoragePaths$ called > $FileEnumThreshold$ times within $EnumWindow$ by app NOT IN $FileEnumAllowList$]; Network Traffic Flow via Android Enterprise Network Logging / Enterprise VPN [DevicePolicyManager.retrieveNetworkLogs(): DnsEvent / ConnectEvent; VPN flow metadata]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

tuning.description: Default 100 directory operations within window. Derive from baseline file manager behavior.
Approved file managers, media apps, MDM agent.

log_sources.name: android:EMM
log_sources.channel: Managed package inventory/status and package metadata

log_sources.name: mobile:ForensicArtifacts
log_sources.channel: Dynamic filesystem trace or acquired app-container/filesystem artifacts: opendir() or File.listFiles() on path IN $ExternalStoragePaths$ called > $FileEnumThreshold$ times within $EnumWindow$ by app NOT IN $FileEnumAllowList$

analytics.name: Analytic 1789
analytics.guidance: For iOS, detect File and Directory Discovery by correlating analyst-visible device/network evidence and management state; use streaming or batched telemetry only where the documented collector is deployed. Correlate Application State via Apple MDM [InstalledApplicationList / ManagedApplicationList]; Host Status via Apple MDM [DeviceInformation / SecurityInfo / ProfileList / restrictions and compliance queries]; Network Traffic Flow via Apple Network Extension / Enterprise VPN [NEFilterFlow / per-app VPN / secure-web-gateway flow metadata]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

tuning.description: Banking, auth, enterprise apps with sensitive local data.
Default 2 — single app could be accidental; multiple indicates targeted environment.
Default 5 connections to same dest within window.
Default 50KB per request — file listing and small file pickups.

log_sources.name: iOS:MDM
log_sources.channel: DeviceInformation / SecurityInfo / ProfileList / restrictions and compliance queries

log_sources.name: iOS:NetworkExtension
log_sources.channel: NEFilterFlow / per-app VPN / secure-web-gateway flow metadata
